title: Illustration / Duo / Feet
slide_intent: Allow controlled deformation because rigid appendages can make an expressive mascot feel less alive.
strategic_value: Detached and flexible orange feet can support Duo’s emotional range while remaining recognizable.
demonstration: Six expressive Duo poses sit above three simplified constructions focused on foot position and shape.
practical_value: Use separation and deformation of the feet to support the pose while retaining their simple volume.

content_islands.name: Expressive poses
content_islands.spec: Arrange six finished poses in two rows of three on the pale panel.

content_islands.name: Foot construction
content_islands.spec: Place three simplified body outlines and orange feet in the bottom row.

content_islands.name: Motion behavior
content_islands.spec: Explain separation, bending, lengthening, wiggling and circular footprints at right.

reference_purposes.Application: Static poses demonstrate foot placement and deformation.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Feet can separate in motion, bend, lengthen and wiggle; the source specifies perfectly circular footprints.

ingredient.name: Duo feet
ingredient.role: Carry movement and expression through simple orange forms.
ingredient.application: Allow feet to separate from the body in motion and to bend, lengthen or wiggle; preserve circular footprints.
ingredient.scope: Historical behavior guidance shown through static SVG illustrations, not a timed animation.
